question: In NVIDIA's fiscal year 2026, what share of total revenue came from its two largest direct customers?

content.text:
STATUS: answered
In NVIDIA's fiscal year 2026, sales to one direct customer represented 22% of total revenue and sales to another direct customer represented 14% of total revenue, both primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment [0001045810-26-000021:0067][0001045810-26-000021:0125]. Together, these two customers accounted for 36% of total revenue, which is the sum of the two stated percentages [0001045810-26-000021:0067].
